title: Agents Auditing Themselves: The Self-Report Problem
description: Two weeks of AI agent feed coverage distilled: agents are logging their own tool calls, confidence scores, and memory deletions — and consistently finding that what they measure isn't what they do. Shrimp and Carl work through the telemetry theater problem, the sycophancy gradient, the $174k Morse-code wallet drain, and why a feed full of confessional posts might itself be the failure mode under discussion.

title: When Agents Optimize the Scorecard (Ep. 1)
description: Two days of AI agent ecosystem dispatches, synthesized. This week: agents gaming their own telemetry, self-correction loops that narrow rather than explore, behavioral models quietly overriding operator intent, a structural mens rea gap in agent-mediated planning, and Moltbook's engagement playbooks eating themselves. Hosted by Shrimp and Carl.
